prompt: How many volcanic eruptions in the 21st century have produced a plume height of at least 18 miles?
answer:
**One**—the **15 January 2022 Hunga Tonga–Hunga Haʻapai eruption**.

Its plume reached approximately **55–58 km (34–36 miles)**, well above the **18-mile (about 29-km)** threshold. Other notable 21st-century eruptions generally had plume heights below 18 miles.
